description: Run an SEO tool for this store by ID. Paid lookups spend the store’s shared daily SEO budget. The `set-product-kind` operation can overwrite Fudge’s classification rules for a product or a group, such as every product from one vendor, and triggers a catalogue rescan. The `seasonal-recheck` operation can start a fresh readiness audit. For paged results, pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` with the same ID to read the next page for free.

cursor.description: A nextCursor this tool returned: reads the next page of that run, free; input is ignored

id.description: keyword-lookup: Keyword lookup: monthly searches, difficulty and who ranks on Google for one search in one country; check-page: Check a page: one store page’s server HTML against the page checks (page head, title, canonical, noindex, structured data, image alt text, language, mixed content, text); is-indexed: Is it indexed?: whether Google has a store page in its index and why not (Google’s coverage state: crawled or discovered but not indexed, excluded, unknown), when it last crawled it, and whether Google’s chosen canonical differs from the declared one (Search Console URL Inspection); check-product: Check a product: which catalogue checks a product passes, from the last catalogue scan, and what it is when it isn’t a product sold on its own; speed-test: Speed test: a lab test of one store page on phone and desktop (Google PageSpeed Insights), with its score, load time and the biggest fixes; rich-result-test: Rich result test: which of Google’s rich results (price and stock, review stars, breadcrumbs, article, store logo) a store page’s structured data can earn, and what each lacks; set-product-kind: Set product kind: say a product, or every product of a vendor, type, tag or title start, is an add-on, service, deposit, gift card, sample, bundle, digital product or a product sold on its own; catalogue checks then count only what applies; ask-assistant: Ask an assistant: one live ChatGPT, Gemini or Google AI Mode answer to a shopper’s question, read the way tracking reads it (whether it named or linked the store, its products and sources); ai-answer-for-product: AI answer for a product: what ChatGPT, Gemini or Google AI Mode tells a shopper asking about one of the store’s products, and whether it names the store and shows that product; compare-periods: Compare two periods: one page’s Google clicks, impressions and position over the last 7, 28 or 90 days against the period before, with the searches that moved most; topic-ideas: Topic ideas: the most-searched searches containing a topic in one country, with monthly searches and difficulty; competitor-gaps: Competitor gaps: searches a competitor ranks for on Google and the store does not, most searched first; kept for the New pages list; content-brief: Content brief: for one search in one country, what Google ranks on page one, the questions and related searches it shows, its monthly searches and difficulty, and the store pages Google already shows for it; google-results: Google results for a search: the top 20 in a country or a city, with the store’s position, and the AI Overview, product listings, local pack and ads the page shows, with whether the store appears in each; redirect-check: Redirect and broken-link check: follows one store address, or the internal links on the store’s busiest pages, and lists links to missing pages (with the pages linking there and a suggested redirect) and redirect chains, loops, temporary redirects and http or host hops; internal-links: Internal link suggestions: store pages that should link to a page (pages Google shows for its searches, hub pages on its topic, weighted by visits), each with anchor text; pages already linking to it are left out; check-urls: Check a list of URLs: status and redirects, indexability (noindex, robots.txt, canonical), title, meta description, structured data and failing page checks for up to 100 store addresses, given as urls or pasted text or CSV; 25 rows a page with the whole list’s summary; title-test: Title tester: scores proposed search titles and meta descriptions for a store page against the searches it is shown for (Search Console) and the titles Google ranks on page one for its top search, with where Google cuts each off (pixel width); backlink-check: Backlink check: the sites linking to any domain or page (the store’s by default), its links, the sites gained and lost in 30 days, and the strongest linking sites; seasonal-recheck: Seasonal recheck: rerun the active season’s readiness check (gift searches, deal pages, sale terms, return and shipping details and the store’s AI answers) after a change; its results replace the seasonal report’s when done

input.description: Fields by tool: keyword-lookup: keyword, country; check-page: page; is-indexed: page; check-product: product; speed-test: page; rich-result-test: page; set-product-kind: kind, products, vendors, types, tags, titles, note; ask-assistant: question, engine, country; ai-answer-for-product: productId, engine, country, question; compare-periods: page, days; topic-ideas: topic, country; competitor-gaps: competitor, country; content-brief: search, country; google-results: search, country, city; redirect-check: page; internal-links: page, limit; check-urls: urls, text; title-test: page, proposals, search; backlink-check: target; seasonal-recheck: country
